dedupe_keys.name: motulator motor drive and grid converter models

description: motulator is Aalto University's Python package for simulating electric-machine drives and grid converters with control algorithms. It combines continuous-time physical models with discrete-time controllers, covering induction and synchronous machines, magnetic saturation, mechanical dynamics, converter filters and DC buses. Inputs are electrical and mechanical parameters, controller settings, references and external loads; outputs include dynamic states, currents, speed and plotted responses. Coverage is user-configured at equipment level. Public source and worked examples are free under MIT, with the reviewed version requiring Python 3.12 or newer. A limitation is that control-oriented component models do not replace a detailed network or switching study, and validation claims in the README concern particular laboratory implementations. motulator can test converter and motor-control components for electricity and industrial-energy simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa) for system planning. The repository provides complete drive and grid examples and a Zenodo software citation. No measured flux maps, laboratory files or simulation output were downloaded.
